_readme: Indicative adult single-day lift ticket prices in USD, for budgeting only. 'verified' entries carry a published 2025-26 rate with its source; most come from OnTheSnow's published adult weekday rates, used as one consistent source so resorts are comparable. Where only a weekday rate was available the high end is estimated at 1.5x to represent holiday/window pricing, which is roughly the observed spread. Everything else inherits a regional tier band and is marked estimated. Nearly every large resort now prices dynamically by date and lead time, so these are a planning range and never a quote; the resort's own site, linked on every resort row, is the only authority.

us_premium.label: US premium destination
us_premium.note: Holiday window rates at the top US resorts now push past $300; advance online purchase is typically 25-40% less.

alps_premium.label: Alps premium
alps_premium.note: Even the most expensive Alpine resorts undercut mid-tier US resorts on lift tickets. This is the single biggest cost difference between a US and a European ski trip.

balkans.label: Balkans / Eastern Europe
balkans.note: The cheapest lift tickets of any developed ski region, typically a third of Alpine prices and a fifth of US ones.

caucasus_central_asia.label: Caucasus / Türkiye / Central Asia
caucasus_central_asia.note: Very low lift costs, though travel and logistics usually dominate the budget for these destinations.

australia.label: Australia
australia.note: Expensive relative to terrain served — Australian day tickets rival mid-tier US resorts.
